title: enterprise-security-rfi-and-audit-triage-playbook
creator: Alicia Park
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers and partners routinely submit security questionnaires, audit requests, and data-processing agreements (DPAs). Current handling is ad hoc: PMs, Solutions, and Security each follow different heuristics which leads to slow SLAs, inconsistent answers, repeated asks to engineering, and missed legal or technical blockers.

Goal: Produce a lightweight, scalable triage playbook and routing rules for incoming security & compliance requests (SOC2/ISO evidence requests, HIPAA attestation asks, GDPR/DPA drafts, vendor questionnaires) that: 1) reduces time-to-first-response to <= 3 business days for standard asks; 2) assigns a risk/effort score for prioritization; 3) automatically routes to the right owner (PM/Security/Legal/Eng/SE); and 4) produces templated responses and artifacts to avoid repeated engineering work.

Scope: Excludes full remediation projects (those become separate ENG or SE initiatives). Includes intake, scoring rubric, routing, templated evidence bundles, and an internal dashboard for tracking SLAs and status.

Approach: 1) Define canonical intake form (RFI) with fields to capture requester type, required evidence, compliance standard, desired SLA, data residency concerns, and point-of-contact. 2) Create a triage rubric (impact, technical dependency, legal risk, compliance complexity) mapping to a 1-10 score and default SLA tiers. 3) Implement routing rules (auto-assign to Security for legal/risk >7, to SE for product integration asks, to PM for clarifications). 4) Author template bundles for common asks: SOC2 evidence pack, GDPR data flow summary, HIPAA controls matrix, sample DPA redlines. 5) Build a lightweight tracking view in Console (or internal DB) with status, owner, and audit log.

Outcomes: Faster, consistent responses; fewer engineer interruptions for repeatable evidence; clearer prioritization for complex requests; audit trail for legal and sales.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical intake form (Google Form + internal API endpoint) defined and published
Triage rubric documented with example scoring for 10 sample customer asks
Routing matrix implemented as a runbook and validated with Security and Legal
Three template evidence bundles authored (SOC2, GDPR, DPA) and stored in shared drive
SLA dashboard prototype showing time-to-first-response and current queue status
Training session held for SE/PM/Sales with recording and one-pager
